models.name: cream corduroy La-Z-Boy power recliner
models.note: Owner-supplied model, slimmed from recliner-lazboy.glb (746k to 80k triangles, normals recomputed on load). No product size was given: scaled to a typical recliner, about 41" tall (37" W x 41" D). Against the west wall facing into the room, per the owner's layout. Upholstered in cream corduroy (wide wale, about 3 per inch), drawn procedurally in 13-models.js.

models.name: honey-wood slatted crib
models.note: Owner-supplied model. No product size was given: scaled to a standard full-size crib, 53.5" long (about 28" W x 33" H). Long side against the west wall, per the owner's layout.

models.name: honey-wood slatted crib (second bedroom)
models.note: A copy of the nursery crib for the second bedroom, the same model and size. Long side against the north wall, west of the door.

models.name: Thomasville recliner (second bedroom)
models.note: Owner-supplied model, shown reclined with its footrest out. No product size was given: scaled to a typical recliner, 36" wide (about 40.5" tall, 68" deep reclined). Back to the west wall, right beside the crib (on the north wall), facing into the room.

models.name: natural rattan daybed with rust-red bedding and patterned pillows
models.note: Owner-supplied model, slimmed from daybed.glb (1.1M to 150k triangles, texture seams locked so the bedding texture stays clean, full 2048 texture kept); true to scale in metres (75" L x 38" D x 35" H). Back against the east wall, per the owner's layout.

models.name: Compton sofa
models.note: Owner-supplied model. No product size was given: scaled to a typical low, deep sofa, 96" wide (about 64" deep, 27" tall). In the lower-level sitting room, centred on the 100" projector screen on the west wall and facing it, about 11 ft back.

models.name: Crate & Barrel Drift sectional, Moss
models.note: Owner-supplied model (drift-moss.glb, 374k triangles, 11.1 MB), slimmed with gltfpack -si 0.22 to drift-moss.opt.glb (82k triangles, 2.3 MB, textures kept). Not to scale: scaled to the Crate & Barrel Drift pieces' 29.5" height, which gives 125" x 92", about a three-piece L of Drift pieces (wedge, armless and arm chairs, 129" x 95"). Stands in for both halves of the old sectional: corner in the north-east, long side along the east wall, short side under the rear windows.
